LESSON: KUSOMA 11.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFASAHA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: USHURU Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zili
Topic 11.2: Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha
3. Practise Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 11.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFASAHA
This lesson teaches Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha for Grade 6 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha above.
2. Explain Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha
3. Practise Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha at school and at home
